{{Top|leg}}
'''Jaaruls Street''' was a road in [[Cuipernam]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was the location on an unnamed building in which [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], the clanless [[Ansionian]] enforcers of [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], took the [[Kidnapping of Barriss Offee|kidnapped]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the Jedi [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]].<ref name="AS" />
